cv.NAME: Georgios Feidakis
cv.TITLE: Senior Software Engineer
cv.ABOUT_PARAGRAPH: I’m a passionate Software Engineer with strong expertise in Angular, TypeScript, React / Next JS and modern front-end technologies like Tailwind, Prime NG, Material, Bootstrap, and responsive design. I have hands-on experience building scalable web applications, integrating RESTful APIs, and contributing to full-stack projects with C#, Node.js, and SQL. In addition to development, I’ve worked on DevOps pipelines using Azure Dev ops, Jenkins and Docker, helping streamline deployments and improve delivery efficiency. I’m driven by clean code, continuous learning, and being part of collaborative teams that build purposeful tech.

cv.EXP2_DESC2: Built reusable, templated frontend solutions using custom Angular components and integrated APIs to support dynamic data, user interactions, and platform-specific workflows.
cv.EXP2_DESC3: Led the refactoring and upgrade of the EuroElections 2024 voting system from Angular 7 to 18 using Angular Signals, improving performance and maintainability.
cv.EXP2_DESC4: Refactored ERP and fuel station systems using NgRx, responsive design, Jenkins, Docker, and CI/CD practices.

home.name: Georgios Feidakis
home.title: A Senior Software Engineer.
home.intro: I am a software engineer with a passion for web development. I have always been drawn to the front-end side of things, even though I have some understanding in the back-end side of things too. For the past several years, I have focused my learning and practice on Angular, a powerful JavaScript framework for building dynamic, responsive, and scalable web applications.

about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer who is passionate about creating elegant, efficient, and user-friendly web applications. With over 4 years of experience in the industry, I have developed a strong foundation in various programming languages, frameworks, and tools, including HTML / CSS, JS / TS, Angular etc.

I've always loved computers and tinkering with them, which led me to discover my passion for programming and coding. Despite studying Electrical and Electronic Engineering, I never lost sight of this passion and decided to pursue a career in software engineering to combine my academic background with my creative and technical interests.

When I'm not coding, you'll likely find me out on a run or hitting the gym. I believe that regular exercise is not only essential for physical health, but also for mental clarity, stress relief, and overall well-being.

timeline.title: Angular Developer / Full Stack
timeline.body:
Project: REDESIGN & MODERNIZATION OF A LARGE-SCALE EBANKING PLATFORM

Key responsibilities:
1) Contributed to the redesign and modernization of a large-scale eBanking platform, migrating legacy AngularJS functionality to the latest Angular ecosystem.
2) Implemented complex banking workflows across payments, transfers, approvals, and multi-step transactional journeys, ensuring accuracy, usability, and reliable business logic.
3) Translated Figma designs into responsive, production-ready Angular interfaces, supporting rebranding, design consistency, and seamless user experience across devices.
4) Worked on .NET BFF implementations, unit testing, Azure DevOps pipelines, release processes, debugging, refactoring, and maintainable enterprise delivery.

timeline.title: Angular Developer / DevOps Engineer
timeline.body:
Project 1: UPGRADING FUEL STATION INTERNAL SYSTEM

Key responsibilities:
1) Implemented NgRx Store Management and Component Store for enhanced state management in an Angular project, ensuring a predictable data flow between components.
2) Designed and implemented a responsive user interface for mobiles and tablets, utilizing Angular's responsive design features.
3) Led rebranding efforts by incorporating a new color palette, maintaining brand consistency across all components and pages.
4) Conducted thorough code reviews to uphold coding standards, best practices, and ensure maintainable code.
5) Utilized Jenkins for automating CI/CD pipelines, streamlining builds across all environments.

Project 2: REFACTORING OLD FUEL STATION INTERNAL SYSTEM

Key responsibilities:
1) Refactor the ASPX form CRM system into a new Angular-based UI from scratch, incorporating NgRx Store Management and Component Store for enhanced state management, in combination with the PrimeNG library for UI components.
2) Ensuring that the new Angular UI replicates key features and maintains user workflow.
3) Collaborated with backend developers to ensure seamless integration of the new UI.
4) Implemented E2E testing strategies to validate the correctness of the refactored system.
5) Utilized Jenkins for automating CI/CD pipelines, streamlining builds across all environments.

timeline.title: Angular Developer
timeline.body:
Project 1: MAINTAINING INSURANCE SALES WEB APP

Key responsibilities:
1) Served as lead developer on a team responsible for maintaining and enhancing an online insurance sales project developed using 3 separate Angular apps.
2) Conducted code reviews of external partners and trained new team members to ensure consistency and maintain high code quality.
3) Implemented user-friendly interfaces that allowed customers to compare insurance policies and purchase them easily and securely.
4) Managed deployments using Azure Dev Ops and provided general support to ensure the apps run smoothly and securely.

Project 2: REFACTORING OLD BANK INTERNAL SYSTEM

Key responsibilities:
1) Refactor an outdated ASPX form system from scratch using Angular in combination with the material library as a front-end leader, following the recommendations of the Architect.
2) Worked closely with stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into a modern and responsive UI design.
3) Collaborated with backend developers to ensure seamless integration of the new UI with the bank's existing systems and databases.
4) Took on the role of the frontend leader, overseeing the work of other frontend developers to ensure high-quality code and adherence to project timelines.

blogs.title: My Fitness Transformation Story
blogs.description: I used to believe that losing weight wasn't possible for me, but in 2017, I decided to challenge that belief and started running every day. After losing 25 kilograms in a year, I joined a gym and began lifting weights. It wasn't easy, but I never gave up. Even during the COVID lockdowns, I found ways to stay active and stay on track. Now, my fitness journey is a part of my lifestyle, and I'm proud of the person I've become.

blogs.title: My University Graduation journey
blogs.description: I am proud to have fulfilled my goal of getting my degree in electrical and electronic engineering from the University of West Attica. The memories and experiences of my five-year journey will always be cherished, and I am grateful for the people I have met and still keep in touch with. I want to thank everyone who supported me during these years, especially those who attended my graduation ceremony.
